apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: secondary-restic
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    pid /tmp/nginx.pid;
    events {}
    http {
      access_log off;
      server_tokens off;
      client_body_temp_path /tmp/client-body;
      proxy_temp_path /tmp/proxy;
      map $remote_user $repository_backend {
        default http://127.0.0.1:8003;
        reader http://127.0.0.1:8002;
        writer http://127.0.0.1:8000;
        admin http://127.0.0.1:8001;
      }
      server {
        listen 8443 ssl;
        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
        ssl_certificate /tls/tls.crt;
        ssl_certificate_key /tls/tls.key;
        client_max_body_size 0;
        location / { return 404; }
        location /alpha/ {
          auth_basic "Restic alpha";
          auth_basic_user_file /auth/alpha/htpasswd;
          proxy_request_buffering off;
          proxy_read_timeout 600s;
          proxy_pass $repository_backend;
        }
      }
      # This listener is reachable only inside the Pod. Data remains read-only
      # for readers, but Restic may create/remove its native lock objects.
      server {
        listen 127.0.0.1:8002;
        client_max_body_size 0;
        location ~ "^/alpha/locks/[a-f0-9]{64}$" {
          limit_except GET POST DELETE { deny all; }
          proxy_request_buffering off;
          proxy_read_timeout 600s;
          proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8001;
        }
        location / {
          limit_except GET { deny all; }
          proxy_read_timeout 600s;
          proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8001;
        }
      }
      server {
        listen 127.0.0.1:8003;
        location / { return 403; }
      }
    }

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: primary-restic-copy-alpha
  labels:
    bartl-restic/replication: "alpha"
spec:
  schedule: "* * * * *"
  timeZone: "Etc/UTC"
  suspend: false
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 60
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    metadata:
      labels:
        bartl-restic/replication: "alpha"
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            bartl-restic/replication: "alpha"
        spec:
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          restartPolicy: Never
          affinity:
            podAffinity:
              requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                - labelSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      app.kubernetes.io/name: primary-restic
                  topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
          containers:
            - name: restic
              image: docker.io/restic/restic:0.19.1
              command: [/bin/sh, -ec]
              args:
                - |
                  test "$RESTIC_REST_USERNAME" = writer || { echo 'Replication requires the destination writer account' >&2; exit 1; }
                  exec restic --cacert /destination/ca.crt --verbose copy --from-repo /source --from-password-file /source-credentials/password
              env:
                - name: RESTIC_REPOSITORY
                  value: "rest:https://secondary-restic.restic-copy-mvzjdyk2-c994b4.svc/alpha/"
                - name: RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE
                  value: /destination/password
                - name: RESTIC_REST_USERNAME

                      name: "secondary-writer"
                      key: username
                - name: RESTIC_REST_PASSWORD
                  valueFrom:
                    secretKeyRef:
                      name: "secondary-writer"
                      key: restPassword
              volumeMounts:
                - name: source
                  mountPath: /source
                  subPath: "alpha"
                  readOnly: false
                - name: source-credentials
                  mountPath: /source-credentials
                  readOnly: true
                - name: destination
                  mountPath: /destination
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: source

                claimName: "primary-data"
            - name: source-credentials
              secret:
                secretName: "source-key"
                items:
                  - key: password

            - name: destination
